children: The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) priced a $1.5 billion five-year US dollar sukuk at 48 basis points over the five-year SOFR mid-swap rate after attracting more than $2.75 billion in orders.

The multilateral lender tightened pricing from IPTs of around 50bp over the benchmark following strong investor demand. The final order book exceeded $2.75 billion, including $250 million from joint lead managers (JLMs).
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Brinda Darasha)

title: IsDB prices $1.5bln five-year USD sukuk
